# Almanac: Harbor View Condominium Association
Version: 4
Compiled: 2027-01-02
As of: 2027-01-02 (board local date)
Board folder: Board Documents
Sources: 18 processed, 0 excluded
Completeness: complete
Open conflicts: 1
Provisional items: 2
Model route: NAS local model

## At a glance

## Monthly fee and budget

Current rule: $240 per unit per month.
Effective: 2026-03-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026"

Superseded:
- 2025-03-01 to 2026-03-01: $225 per unit. Source: minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $225 per unit, effective March 1, 2025" (carried 3-0)
- Corrected: $230 stated in notice-2025-02-10-fees.pdf ("From March 1, 2025 the monthly common charge will be $230 per unit."). Correction in minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "the notice of February 10, 2025 stating $230 was in error. The adopted charge is $225 per unit."
- 2024-03-01 to 2025-03-01: $210 per unit. Source: minutes-2024-01-18.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $210 per unit, effective March 1, 2024" (carried 3-0)
- Proposed, not adopted: $235 from 2025-03-01. Source: agenda-2025-01-23.pdf; minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "The proposed charge of $235 was amended."
- Informational, not a rule: newsletter-2025-12.pdf reports owner questions about a $250 charge.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Special assessments

Current rule: No rule recorded in the processed documents. This is not a finding that no rule exists.
Effective: none recorded
Set by: none
Evidence: none

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pets

Current rule: Up to 2 pets per unit. Registration with management is required. No weight limit.
Effective: 2025-04-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is r

emoved; registration with management is still required."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: One pet per unit; dogs may not exceed 35 pounds. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit may keep one (1) pet." and "Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Renovations and work hours

Current rule: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.; no work on Sundays or holidays.
Effective: 2024-07-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-06-12, motion carried 3-0; restated in notice-2024-07-01-renovation-hours.pdf
Evidence: minutes-2024-06-12.docx: "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2024-07-15: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; no work on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No work is permitted on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Balconies and exterior fixtures

Current rule: No fixtures, appliances or equipment on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval. Heat pump outdoor units are permitted with written approval if floor-mounted, not attached to the railing, and rated at no more than 60 dB(A). Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies.
Effective: 2019-05-01 for the approval requirement and the barbecue prohibition; 2025-01-23 (decision date) for the heat pump rule
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01; board meeting minutes, 2025-01-23, heat pump motion carried 2-1
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No fixtures, appliances or equipment may be mounted on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval." and "Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies."
Evidence: minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "heat pump outdoor units are permitted on balconies with written board approval, provided they are floor-mounted and not attached to the railing, and have a rated sound level of no more than 60 dB(A)."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: Electric barbecues. board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:10: "So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight." No vote was taken; the prohibition above remains in force.

## Quiet hours

Current rule: Friday and Saturday nights 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Quiet hours on all other nights remain 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
Effective: 2026-10-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-09-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-09-15.docx: "amend House Rule 6 so that quiet hours on Friday and Saturday nights are 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m." and "Quiet hours on all other nights remain 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2026-10-01: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Rentals and leasing

Current rule: Minimum lease term is thirty (30) days.
Effective: 2025-04-15 (effective immediately on adoption)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 2-1
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "amend House Rule 8 so that the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately. Motion carried 2-1."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: Minimum six (6) months. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Units may not be leased for a term of less than six (6) months."
- Failed, not adopted: leases of seven (7) days or more. Source: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "permit leases of seven (7) days or more. Motion failed 1-2."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Parking

Current rule: Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 24 hours. Each unit has one assigned space.
Effective: 2027-01-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-11-10, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-11-10.docx: "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehi

cles may stay in guest parking for no more than 24 hours. Effective January 1, 2027."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit has one assigned space."

Superseded:
- 2025-10-01 to 2027-01-01: No more than 48 hours. Source: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025."
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-10-01: No more than 72 hours. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 72 hours."

Scheduled: none (the 24-hour rule took effect 2027-01-01, before this compile)
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Electric vehicle charging

Current rule: Owners may install a charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost.
Effective: 2026-01-20 (decision date; no effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pool and amenities

Current rule: Conflict. The documents give two sets of hours for the 2026 season: 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily, or 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily. No pool hours are recorded for later seasons.
Effective: 2026 season
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (for the 2026 season); notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf (no vote recorded)

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2026 season: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily, June 1 to September 15. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The pool is open 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15." Replaced for the 2026 season by minutes-2025-09-10.pdf.
- Informational: notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf: "The pool opens on June 1, 2026." newsletter-2025-12.pdf: "The pool is closed for the winter."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts:
- minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily."
- notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily."
Provisional: board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:45: "Someone said the notice says nine pm, but I thought we said ten." The objection was deferred; no later minutes resolve it.

## Vendor contracts

Current rule: The Bramblewick Grounds LLC landscaping agreement ran from 2024-04-01 to 2026-03-31 and was not renewed. Its monthly fee was $1,450. No replacement landscaping agreement is recorded in the processed documents.
Effective: 2026-03-31 (end of term)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (decision not to renew)
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "the Association will not renew the Bramblewick Grounds agreement at the end of its term."
Evidence: contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf: "This agreement runs from April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026."

Superseded:
- 2024-04-01 to 2026-03-31: Bramblewick Grounds LLC agreement, $1,450 per month, renewing for one-year terms unless written notice is given at least 60 days before the term ends, with any renewal increase capped at 4%. Source: contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf (signed 2024-01-25); award in minutes-2024-01-18.pdf (carried 3-0). Quote: "renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60

) days before the end of the current term."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Officers and elections

Current rule: The board has three directors: President, Treasurer and Secretary. A quorum is two directors. The Treasurer resigned, and the board appointed a new Treasurer to serve until the next annual meeting.
Effective: 2025-09-10 (decision date; no effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "The board appointed a new Treasurer to serve until the next annual meeting. Motion carried 3-0."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The Association is governed by a board of three directors: a President, a Treasurer and a Secretary. A quorum is two directors."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Governance and amendments

Current rule: Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds vote of unit owners at an annual meeting. House rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board.
Effective: 2019-05-01
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "These Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting." and "The House Rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Changelog

## v4, 2027-01-02
- Rebuilt from 18 files. New since v3: none. Compile triggered because the scheduled guest parking change reached its effective date, 2027-01-01.
- Changed: Parking. Guest parking up to 24 hours is now the current rule, in force since 2027-01-01 (previously scheduled).
- Changed: Vendor contracts. The Bramblewick Grounds agreement ended 2026-03-31 and was not renewed. The non-renewal notice was due 2026-01-30 and is recorded as sent 2026-02-02.
- Changed: Provisional items. Deferred pool-hours objection from board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a added (2 provisional items, previously 1).
- Added empty topic sections: Special assessments, Waste and recycling, Insurance. No records in the processed documents.
- Unchanged: Monthly fee and budget, Pets, Renovations and work hours, Balconies and exterior fixtures, Quiet hours, Rentals and leasing, Electric vehicle charging, Officers and elections, Governance and amendments. Pool and amenities remains a conflict.
- No new conflicts. No exclusions.

End of almanac v4.
